Batch 85 = RULING 93 AS AMENDED, the render side (orchestrator 2026-11-14 '21:10', relayed by the builder, in substance): "a clip whose source-burned captions the 9:16 crop cuts mid-word is 16:9-ONLY (sealed formats: ['16x9']); the integrator renders and delivers that format alone, unless a crop exists that shows them whole." Found on the Blockware spotlight 3f481f5a (run pinned_20261115_013448): the 16:9 passed every gate; the 9:16 crop shows 'D MY' for the source's burned 'SOLD MY'.
The pin field (agreed with the builder): moments_package["formats"] = ["16x9"], INSIDE the pin's seal package_sha256 (scripts/integrator/check_pin_only.py:30-31 recomputes the seal before launch; pinned.build_edl records the render's own digest of the whole package, moments_package_pin_sha256, pinned.py:717, unchanged); absent = both formats. pinned.py is NOT changed (it is an input of the pre-check's decoder sha).
The change:
(1) release_auth: release_formats(edl) = FORMATS when the EDL has no 'formats', else exactly ('16x9',) or ('16x9','9x16') from a list in that order; anything else ValueError. package_formats(mp) reads the pin field the same way (None when absent). bound(formats) = the bound files minus the non-released formats' final, manifest and sheet. attest(): the EDL's formats (unreadable -> HOLD with every format checked and bound); blockers (release_auth.py:111, unchanged) only for released formats; only their finals/manifests must be the bytes the gates measured; the attestation records 'formats'. authorise(): re-reads the EDL's formats NOW (unreadable -> refused), refuses when the attestation's 'formats' differ, checks blockers and every bound digest (the EDL is bound) for those formats only.
(2) run_fresh: stage_pinned copies the sealed formats into edl.json after pinned.prepare (a malformed value -> Hold "pinned decision rejected"); release_verdict (moved out of run_tail): CANDIDATE only when every released format passes (unreadable formats -> a hold); every format's verdict still recorded in PROVENANCE; attest_run (run_fresh.py:1533, unchanged) turns any hold into HOLD.
(3) telegram: deliver_run still authorises first (telegram.py:238) and snapshot verifies the EDL and gate report bytes against the attestation (telegram.py:45-55); _plan sends the released formats' finals and sheets only and refuses when the verified EDL's formats differ from the attested ones; the caption of a 16:9-only send carries SIXTEEN_NINE_ONLY; headline numbers are checked on the released formats' G18 readings. review_drop / review_nonpass / review_texts: the EDL's formats only (unreadable -> nothing sent), so a 16:9-only run's 9:16 rows neither block nor appear.
(4) check_pin_only: reports the formats; a malformed value is not ready.
Tonight the 9:16 is still RENDERED and gated for a 16:9-only run (its rows reported, never deciding, never sent); skipping its render is a later change.
Tests: TestReleaseFormats (6), TestRunFreshFormats (2), test_telegram_delivery ruling 93 (2), test_review_drop ruling 93 (3). On the old code (cb060adc) 12 of them fail; the 2 that pass are the unchanged must-fails (both formats: the 9:16 failure still holds / refuses).
FIND: a fail-open (a format released that the pin did not seal; a 9:16 sent or attested ALL_PASS for a run whose formats are absent or both; a 16:9-only release while its own 16:9 rows, files or digests fail); a malformed or tampered 'formats' (EDL or attestation) that releases anything; a send path that reads the 9:16 for a 16:9-only run; a both-format run whose behaviour changed. Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.
